info.title: Electrical and Plumbing Services API
info.description: API for managing electrical and plumbing services with Better Auth and Admin features.

post.summary: Sign up with email, password, and role selection
post.description: Custom sign-up endpoint with role selection. The default Better Auth sign-up endpoint is disabled.

201.description: User created successfully. Verification code sent to your email.

message.example: User created successfully. Verification code sent to your email.

token.description: Bearer token for authentication - use this in Authorization header

400.description: Invalid input or user already exists

oneOf.example: Email, password, and name are required
Role must be one of: user, admin, worker

post.summary: Sign in with social provider (Google, etc.)
post.description: Initiates social authentication flow. Returns OAuth URL for redirect or direct redirect based on disableRedirect parameter.

provider.description: Social provider to use for authentication

callbackURL.description: URL to redirect after successful authentication (optional)

disableRedirect.description: If true, returns OAuth URL instead of redirecting (optional)

200.description: OAuth URL returned (when disableRedirect is true)

302.description: Redirect to OAuth provider (when disableRedirect is false or not provided)

error.example: Invalid provider or provider not configured

post.summary: Sign in with email and password

post.description: Verify email address using the 6-digit code sent to your email after registration. User must be signed in.

error.example: Please sign in to verify your email

post.description: Request a new 6-digit verification code to be sent to your email. User must be signed in.

message.example: Verification code sent to your email

error.example: Please sign in to resend verification code

email.description: Email address to send reset link

get.description: Get Uppy client configuration for file uploads. Specify type to get appropriate restrictions.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Upload type: image (5MB, images only), document (10MB, PDF/DOC), any (10MB, all types)

parameters.name: maxFiles
parameters.description: Maximum number of files (only applies when multiple=true)

error.example: Invalid type. Must be one of: image, document, any

post.description: Upload single or multiple files. Use with Uppy for better UX. Max size: 10MB per file.

400.description: Invalid file or file too large

oneOf.example: Only image files are allowed (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP)

delete.description: Delete one or more previously uploaded files. Users can only delete their own files.

403.description: Forbidden - Can only delete own files

error.example: You can only delete your own files
Current password and new password are required

get.description: Get authenticated user profile. If user is an engineer, also returns engineer profile data including verification status, location, bank details, and assigned services.

200.description: User profile (includes engineer profile if applicable)

engineerProfile.description: Engineer profile data (null if user is not an engineer)

put.description: Update basic user profile information (name, phone, image). Use separate /api/user/bio-address endpoint for bio and address.

image.description: Profile image URL (optional, upload via Uppy first)

get.description: Get user home address. Works for both customers and engineers.

put.description: Update user bio and home address. Works for both customers and engineers. Both fields are optional.

bio.example: Experienced homeowner looking for reliable professionals.

homeAddress.description: Home address (optional, set to null to remove)

get.description: Get list of all service categories. Public endpoint - no authentication required.

error.example: Name, price, and categoryId are required

get.description: Get list of online engineers who can handle the booking service, sorted by distance. Includes reviews.

parameters.name: bookingId
parameters.description: Booking ID to get available engineers for

200.description: List of available engineers with reviews

post.description: Create a booking with priority, issue details, photos, and location. **Emergency bookings**: Do NOT send scheduledDate/scheduledTime - they are auto-set to now + 60 minutes. **Standard bookings**: Must provide scheduledDate and scheduledTime.

priority.description: Priority: "emergency" (60-min response, auto-scheduled) or "standard" (user provides date/time)

scheduledDate.description: **REQUIRED for standard priority only**. Booking date (YYYY-MM-DD). **Do NOT send for emergency** - auto-set to today.

scheduledTime.description: **REQUIRED for standard priority only**. Booking time (HH:MM). **Do NOT send for emergency** - auto-set to now + 60 minutes.

photos.description: Array of photo URLs (max 3, upload via /api/upload first)

example.issueDetails: Power outage in the entire house, urgent help needed

201.description: Booking created successfully with available engineers

availableEngineers.description: List of available engineers sorted by distance

oneOf.example: Service ID, issue details, and location are required
Location must include state, city, streetAddress, and nearestLandmark
Please complete your profile (name, email, phone) before booking
Booking date must be in the future

get.description: Get all bookings for the authenticated customer with pagination and status filtering.

put.description: Customer selects an engineer from available engineers list. Changes booking status from "pending" to "awaiting_engineer". Engineer must then accept or reject.

engineerId.description: Engineer ID from available engineers list

booking.description: Updated booking with engineerId and status=awaiting_engineer

400.description: Invalid input or booking not pending

oneOf.example: Can only select engineer for pending bookings
Engineer not found, offline, or not assigned to this service

put.description: Engineer accepts a booking request. Changes status from "awaiting_engineer" to "confirmed" and creates chat.

chat.description: Created chat between customer and engineer

error.example: Booking is not awaiting engineer response

404.description: Booking not found or not assigned to you

error.example: Booking not found or not assigned to you

put.description: Engineer rejects a booking request. Changes status back to "pending" and removes engineer assignment. Customer can select another engineer.

message.example: Booking rejected. Customer can select another engineer.

booking.description: Updated booking with status=pending and engineerId=null

error.example: Booking is not awaiting engineer response

404.description: Booking not found or not assigned to you

error.example: Booking not found or not assigned to you

get.description: Get all bookings assigned to the authenticated engineer with pagination and status filtering.

403.description: Only engineers can view engineer bookings

error.example: Only engineers can view engineer bookings

post.description: Leave a review and rating for the engineer after booking completion. Updates engineer rating.

400.description: Invalid input or booking not completed

oneOf.example: No engineer was assigned to this booking

error.example: Review already exists for this booking
Only pending or confirmed bookings can be cancelled
Status must be one of: pending, confirmed, in-progress, completed, cancelled

engineerIds.description: Array of engineer IDs to assign

error.example: Engineer IDs must be an array
One or more engineers are already booked at this time

get.description: Get paginated messages for a specific chat. Messages are separated into `customerMessages` and `engineerMessages` arrays for easy display alignment. Automatically marks messages as read when fetched.

customerMessages.description: Messages sent by the customer (display on left for engineer, right for customer)

mediaUrl.description: URL to image/video file (required for image/video types)

engineerMessages.description: Messages sent by the engineer (display on right for engineer, left for customer)

mediaUrl.description: URL to image/video file (required for image/video types)

customerMessages.message: My AC is not cooling properly
Here is a photo of the issue

engineerMessages.message: I can help with that. I will be there in 20 minutes

put.description: Mark all unread messages in a chat as read.

markedCount.description: Number of messages marked as read

get.description: Get wallet details for the authenticated user including balance and statistics.
Get current available balance in the wallet.
Get detailed statistics about wallet transactions and balances.
Get paginated list of wallet transactions with optional filtering by type.

post.description: Initialize a Paystack payment to deposit funds into wallet. Returns authorization URL for payment.

authorizationUrl.description: Redirect user to this URL to complete payment

400.description: Invalid amount or minimum deposit not met

get.description: Verify Paystack payment and credit wallet balance. Call this after user completes payment.
Get a list of all Nigerian banks supported by Paystack. Use this endpoint to get bank codes for bank account operations. No authentication required.

post.description: Add and verify bank account details for withdrawals. Account is verified with Paystack (₦100 fee) and must match user's profile name. Use GET /api/wallet/banks to get list of valid bank names and codes.

accountName.description: Account holder name (optional - will be verified with Paystack)

bankCode.description: Bank code (optional - auto-fetched from bank name if not provided)

200.description: Bank account verified and added successfully

message.example: Bank account verified and added successfully

400.description: Invalid account number, verification failed, or account name mismatch

get.description: Get saved and verified bank account details.

put.description: Update and verify existing bank account details. Account is verified with Paystack (₦100 fee) and must match user's profile name. Use GET /api/wallet/banks to get list of valid bank names and codes.

accountName.description: Account holder name (optional - will be verified with Paystack)

bankCode.description: Bank code (optional - auto-fetched from bank name if not provided)

200.description: Bank account verified and updated successfully

message.example: Bank account verified and updated successfully

400.description: Invalid account number, verification failed, or account name mismatch

post.description: Withdraw earnings from wallet to bank account. Only available for engineers. Requires bank account to be added first. Minimum withdrawal: ₦1,000.

message.example: Withdrawal successful. Funds will be transferred to your bank account within 24 hours.

400.description: Invalid amount, insufficient balance, or bank account not added

post.description: Add funds to wallet via Paystack payment. Only available for customers. Returns authorization URL for payment. Minimum top-up: ₦100.

authorizationUrl.description: Redirect user to this URL to complete payment

400.description: Invalid amount or minimum top-up not met

post.description: Engineer creates a quotation for a confirmed booking after visiting the customer location. Fixed call-out fee of ₦10,000 + labor fee + materials (with breakdown).

materials.description: Array of materials with name, price, and quantity

403.description: Forbidden - only workers can create quotations

get.description: Get quotation details for a specific booking. Accessible by customer or assigned engineer.

403.description: Forbidden - no access to this quotation

put.description: Customer approves the quotation after verifying wallet balance. System checks if customer has sufficient funds before approval. Booking status changes to "payment_pending".

message.example: Quotation approved. Please proceed to payment.

400.description: Bad request - insufficient balance or only pending quotations can be approved

put.description: Customer rejects the quotation. Engineer can revise and resubmit.

400.description: Bad request - only pending quotations can be rejected

put.description: Engineer revises a rejected quotation with new costs. Status changes back to "pending".

400.description: Bad request - only rejected quotations can be revised

get.description: Get all notifications for the authenticated user with pagination. Can filter for unread only.

message.example: Your booking has been confirmed by the engineer.

relatedId.description: ID of related entity (booking, chat, etc.)

actionUrl.description: URL to navigate to when notification is clicked

put.description: Mark a specific notification as read.
Mark all unread notifications as read for the authenticated user.

markedCount.description: Number of notifications marked as read

get.description: Get notification preferences for the authenticated user. Returns default settings (all false) if none exist.

bookingUpdates.description: Status changes, engineer arrival, job completion

promotionsAndOffers.description: Deals, discounts, and new service announcements

put.description: Update notification preferences for the authenticated user. Only provided fields will be updated.

bookingUpdates.description: Status changes, engineer arrival, job completion

promotionsAndOffers.description: Deals, discounts, and new service announcements

get.description: Get all complaints with pagination and status filtering. Includes user details.
